title: Jagged Peppery Mexican Grains Flan
description: A peppery, molten Mexican dish featuring mixed grain, perfect for midnight cravings, this flan is a unique twist on traditional desserts. It is also FODMAP friendly.

ingredients.name: vanilla extract
ingredients.notes: make sure it is gluten free

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the mixed grain cereal, eggs, pepper jack cheese, milk, granulated sugar, vanilla extract, ground black pepper, and salt.
Pour the mixture into 6 ramekins or small cups.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, run a knife around the edges of each ramekin to release the flan.
Place a plate over each ramekin and invert onto the plate.
Serve the flan chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of ground black pepper if desired.
